title: Less Think. More BLINK: Regional Transit Partners Announce BLINK 2026 Service
summary: Metro, TANK, BCRTA and Red Bike announced BLINK 2026 service: Park & Rides, regular service, discounted Transit-app passes on sale Oct. 5, and a $20 Red Bike week pass.

title: Things to Do in the Cincy Region – October 2026
summary: Visit Cincy's October 2026 events roundup, which includes BLINK and Cincinnati Art Week.

title: BLINK fan-favorite returns for 2026 festival
summary: The Asianati Night Market returns to Court Street Plaza during BLINK with 17 food vendors, lion dances, taiko drumming and a Tokyo Kitty cosplay contest.

title: BLINK 2026 brings back familiar favorites — plus a few new features
summary: Preview of BLINK 2026: the Ready. Set. BLINK! opening ceremony, the Turn the Lights On coloring contest, the new Madison Walls murals in Covington, Run the Night on Oct. 6, the Asianati Night Market (Oct. 8-11) and the drone show schedule ("First Sight" Oct. 8; "Dimensions of Wonder" at 8 and 10 p.m. Oct. 9-11).

title: Getting Around Covington During BLINK: Road Closure & Traffic Information
summary: Covington listed its BLINK street closures and the pedestrian Entertainment Destination Center boundaries; the Roebling Bridge closes to vehicles nightly 6:45-11 p.m. Oct. 8-11.

title: CCM students create installation for BLINK 2026
summary: UC College-Conservatory of Music lighting students are creating "Echoes of Light," a lighting installation on Tristan Eaton's music-legends mural at Elm Street Plaza, for BLINK 2026.

title: BLINK in Cincinnati is back this year with a new block party opener and new artists
summary: Republished WCPO report on the new Ready. Set. BLINK! opener, the 2026 artist list and the 2.3 million attendance forecast.

title: BLINK: A Festival of Light & Art Announces Exhibiting Artists for BLINK 2026 Biennial
summary: Chamber release announcing the 90+ artists for BLINK's fifth edition, Oct. 8-11, 2026, including a live fashion show and a pop-up skate park.

title: Blink 2026 Participating Artists
summary: BLINK published its 2026 artist list: 92 artists from 20 countries, 47 of them new to BLINK, 30 from Cincinnati and Northern Kentucky. The release says BLINK 2026 brings the total number of permanent BLINK murals to 75.

title: Organizers scrap opening parade for BLINK kickoff. Here’s what’s replacing it
summary: Organizers replaced the opening parade with Ready. Set. BLINK!, a five-block party around TQL Stadium from 4-9 p.m. on Oct. 8, and released the list of 2026 artists.

title: BLINK 2026 will look different: New opening party, global artists announced
summary: Organizers unveiled 2026 details: about 90 artists from 20 countries chosen from more than 800 submissions, the new Ready, Set, BLINK opening party, 8 to 10 new ArtsWave murals in Covington, and city safety plans.

title: BLINK announces new block party opener, participating artists for 2026 festival
summary: BLINK announced its Ready. Set. BLINK! block-party opener around TQL Stadium and more than 90 artists; executive director Leslie Mooney said organizers forecast about 2.3 million visitors.

title: BLINK 2026 announces major changes coming to the iconic festival
summary: At a Fountain Square announcement, BLINK outlined 2026 changes: 90+ artists, more than ten new murals in Covington, the Ready, Set, BLINK! opener replacing the parade, and an ArtsWave 100th-anniversary installation at the Aronoff Center.

title: BLINK goes international ahead of 2026 art and light festival
summary: BLINK leaders held receptions in London (Somerset House, March 24) and Paris (Galerie Joseph, March 26) to promote the festival and the Cincinnati region to international audiences and investors.

title: Blink Jumps the Pond as Cincinnati Chases Global Cash

title: BLINK goes international ahead of 2026 art and light festival
summary: BLINK organizers traveled to London and Paris ahead of the 2026 festival to build international awareness and economic-development ties.

title: Leslie Mooney to make Blink 'radically welcoming' | People to Watch
summary: Enquirer "People to Watch 2026" profile of BLINK executive director Leslie Mooney, who calls "radically welcoming" the festival's unofficial theme; describes BLINK as a $7.5-8 million endeavor.

title: Cincinnati's Blink festival to illuminate the city once more in 2026, says creator
summary: Video interview in which BLINK co-creator Andrew Salzbrun talks about what it takes to put on the festival.

title: BLINK announces 2026 dates, deadline for artists to apply
summary: BLINK announced Oct. 8-11, 2026 dates and opened its call to artists with an Oct. 8 deadline.

title: BLINK® Announces 2026 Dates and Opens Call to Artists
summary: BLINK announced it will return October 8-11, 2026 and opened its Call to Artists with an October 8, 2025 deadline, citing 944 submissions from artists in 65 countries for 2024.

title: BLINK 2026 dates announced: Here’s what we know
summary: The Cincinnati Regional Chamber announced BLINK will return Oct. 8-11, 2026 and opened its call to artists; the 2024 edition featured 37 projection mapping projects, 31 light-based installations and 19 permanent murals.

title: BLINK announces 2026 dates, deadline for artists to apply
summary: BLINK announced Oct. 8-11, 2026 dates and opened its call to artists with an Oct. 8 deadline.

title: Leslie Mooney Named Executive Director of BLINK®
summary: The Cincinnati Regional Chamber named Leslie Mooney, executive director of the Clifton Cultural Arts Center since 2013, as BLINK vice president and executive director, starting in July 2025.

title: BLINK 2024 ANNOUNCES IMPRESSIVE REGIONAL AND GLOBAL ROSTER OF ARTISTS TO LIGHT UP CINCINNATI THIS OC
summary: BLINK announced more than 80 artists for its October 17-20, 2024 edition, listing muralists, projection artists and light-based artists, and noted that CODAsummit chose Cincinnati for 2024 in collaboration with BLINK.

title: BLINK™, Illuminated by ArtsWave, Calls for Artists to Illuminate Cincinnati Once Again in 2024
summary: BLINK opened its call for artists for the October 17-20, 2024 festival, accepting projection mapping, mural and light installation proposals from September 19 to December 15, 2023, with no application fee.

title: BLINK™, Illuminated by ArtsWave, Returns in 2024 to Light Up Cincinnati For Its Fourth Edition
summary: BLINK announced a fourth edition for October 17-20, 2024, including projection mapping on Music Hall, with Justin Brookhart returning as executive director. The release cites 2.1 million attendees in 2022 from 29 states and 71 artists.

title: BLINK® Delivers $126M Direct Economic Impact for the Region
summary: The Cincinnati USA Regional Chamber released the 2022 economic impact report: over 2 million attendees, $126 million in direct economic impact and 1,687 jobs supported or created.

title: Iconic Muralist Tristan Eaton Completes Largest Mural in Ohio for BLINK
summary: Tristan Eaton completed an estimated 18,000-square-foot mural on the 84.51° headquarters, commissioned for BLINK and described as Ohio's largest, honoring Cincinnati music legends.

title: BLINK® Brings 2 Million to Cincinnati & Northern Kentucky
summary: BLINK 2022 drew over 2 million attendees across Cincinnati and Covington, opening with a parade on 5th Street and featuring nightly drone shows.
